title: Type automatic qualification refusal reasons and cover reverse classification exhaustively
outcome: Material and availability classifications use a compiler-checked shared type rather than reason-string agreement across verification and requalification modules.
acceptance: Material identity/protocol/schema/platform and authenticated authority refusals remain fatal; availability/settling failures remain retryable through typed classification.
Tests cover successful reverse payload mismatches, authenticated reverse refusals and availability responses, and report serialization retains explicit readable reasons.
